_note: No `include` and no `files` anywhere in the tsconfig chain, so the compiler defaults `include` to `**/*` and every component and module beside the tsconfig is in the project, as svelte-check --tsgo also has it since 4.7.7. A missing `.svelte` import in them reports TS2307 and nothing else, as the default svelte-check engine does. `exclude` still keeps `dist` out, so its missing import is not reported. The TSGO-ENHANCEMENT check used to treat such a project as containing nothing, so both imports went unreported.
